title: Grilled Chicken Inasal
description: A classic filipino dish marinated in a mixture of vinegar, garlic, and spices, then grilled to perfection.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine patis, kalamansi juice, black pepper, garlic, and salt. Blend until smooth.
In a large bowl, combine the blended marinade and chicken breast. Mix well to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Remove the chicken from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off.
Grill the chicken for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
